OPSTRACER / DESIGN SYSTEM 02

OpsTracer identity, rebuilt on a quieter product foundation.

The logo, brand typography, amber action hierarchy, and operational semantics remain ours. Summation contributes the compact shell, spacing discipline, component geometry, and restrained borders—not the identity.

12 / COVERAGE

A system, not a copied application

DS-02
Retained from OpsTracer
  • Production logo assets and lockup rules
  • Host Grotesk + DM Mono reading model
  • Brand amber action hierarchy
  • Incident, evidence, escalation and on-call semantics
  • Operational state colours and domain language
Replaced using the audits
  • One 1376px content rail and light product surface
  • 36/32/28px buttons, 44/32px fields, 18px tags
  • Compact tabs, sidebar, breadcrumbs, menus and calendar
  • Complete Profile, Addison, Users, Usage, Billing and OAuth settings shell
  • Rounded list/table shells, restrained dividers, and consistent field focus
